description:
General Information
New in the Original Packaging – (Unless Bulk Packed)
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Rear Differential LEVEL 3 Repair Kit for the SJ413 / Suzuki Samurai 86-95
Fits: Front & Rear – Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989
Fits: Rear (only) – Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995
Suzuki OEM Pinion Gear Set & Pinion Shafts (#1 & #2)
High Quality Bearings made to Japanese Standards
Suzuki OEM Rear Side Gear Set
Plus Much More!
Puts Everything you Need to Complete the Install in One Affordable Kit!
Direct Replacement
Level 3 Kit Includes:
Bearings:
Qty 1 – Pinion (Inner) Bearing
Qty 1 – Outer Bearing
Qty 2 – Side Bearings
Oil Seal:
Qty 1 (Behind Flange)
Shims:
9 pc Set – Varying Thickness
Nut:
Qty 1 – Pinion Nut
Spacer:
Qty 1 – Spacer Bevel Pinion
Marking Kit:
Qty 1 – Brush
Qty 1 – Paint (yellow)
Washers:
8 pc Set – Pinion Gear Washers (1.0mm)
8 pc Set – Pinion Gear Washers (1.5mm)
Thrust Washers:
4 pc Set – Thrust Washers (1.0mm)
4 pc Set – Thrust Washers (1.5mm)
Qty 4 – Pinion Gears
Qty 1 – #1 Pinion Shaft
Qty 2 – #2 Pinion Shaft
Qty 2 – Side Gears (Rear Diff)
Qty 2 – Bearing Lock Plate
Qty 2 – Bolt, Bearing Lock Plate
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Level 3 Differential Kit (see above)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1989 Front & Rear Differentials
Suzuki Samurai 1990 – 1995 Rear Differential (only)
